narrative: The expanded early-stage data weakened the initial clinical signal. That is a reason to revisit confidence in the small cohorts, not a definitive answer about efficacy.

checks.a1: Weakened. Response rates fell as the early cohorts expanded. These uncontrolled data still do not settle efficacy.
checks.a2: Partly supported. The reported receipt of the agreed cash and equity proceeds reduced near-term funding uncertainty. This record does not establish that financing risk disappeared for years.
checks.a3: Unresolved. This record does not establish the value of the drug conditional on success.
checks.a4: Choosing to wait is consistent with uncertainty. This outcome alone cannot tell us whether waiting was the better decision.
checks.a5: Unresolved. A share-price result cannot establish how much clinical success was priced in at entry.

assumptions.text: The early clinical results will hold up as more patients are treated.
The partnership removes the financing risk for years.
The current valuation still leaves enough upside if the drug works.
I don't have enough evidence to take a position either way.
The price already assumes success; the risk is to the downside.
